title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The live record for trend-daily-v005 counts from 1 October 2026, and trend-daily-v006 counts from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That ATOM position exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## What is open and what has closed

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. Separately, the NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open. The ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close is closed: it exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, for -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. These are the engine states read from the running record, not summaries or interpretations.

## What the market filter is allowing

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With the filter off, both trend-daily engines show 0 positions open on paper. Their closest distances to a 20-day breakout are the same three readings: UNIUSDT is 8.40% below its high, BNBUSDT is 9.00% below its high, and TRXUSDT is 9.82% below its high. The record states the filter state and the distances; it does not state why the filter is off or when it may change. No positions are open in either trend-daily engine at the read time, so there is no active trend-daily exposure in the paper record.

## What the record does and does not show

The live window is short: v005 counts from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades with an average null net per trade, so its early average is not a settled result. The trend-daily averages are negative so far: -13.22% net per trade across 6 trades for v005 and -13.34% net per trade across 7 trades for v006. The single closed ATOM trade is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a statement about the tested distribution, not a claim about these specific trades. The record updates continuously, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## How to check the same numbers

The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status post carry the same figures as this article. The open NEAR entry remains at its 5.896 entry from 12 October 2026. The closed ATOM entry remains at its 2.066 entry after the 10 October 2026 daily close and its 1.703 exit at the 18 October 2026 close. The trend-daily closed-trade counts remain 6 for v005 and 7 for v006, with averages -13.22% and -13.34% net per trade. The htf-rsi-v007 closed-trade count remains 4 with an average null net per trade. The filter states remain off for both trend-daily engines, and the three breakout distances remain 8.40%, 9.00%, and 9.82%. Because the record updates continuously, later reads may differ; this article reports the record as read, without projection.
